membership.name: Membership

seo.title: Membership Management Software for Associations | Donorfit
seo.description: Manage member registration, dues collection, renewals and member records for associations and nonprofits in one place with Donorfit Membership.

membership.headline: Simplify Membership Management for Your Organisation.
membership.subheadline: Register members, set up plans and categories, collect dues and run renewals from one organised workspace — so your team stops chasing fees.

intro.title: One workspace for plans, applications, members and payments
intro.body: Donorfit Membership gives your organisation a single place to run its membership programme. You define the plans people can join, publish an online application form, review each submission and turn approved applicants into members with an active subscription. Every payment, plan change and cancellation is then recorded on the member’s profile, so your team always works from the same, current information.

problems.problem: Applications arrive on paper, by email and in conversation, and someone has to type each one into a list.
problems.solution: Applicants fill in your online form, shared as a link, a QR code or embedded on your website. Every submission lands in one approval queue.

problems.problem: Member details, plans and payment notes are spread across several spreadsheets that nobody fully trusts.
problems.solution: Each member has one profile with contact details, the data from their application, their subscription, receipts and an activity log.

problems.problem: Monthly or annual fees are collected by hand, and it is hard to see who has paid and whose payment failed.
problems.solution: Subscriptions bill on a monthly or annual cycle through your connected payment gateway. Failed and upcoming billings are shown in the subscriptions overview.

features.title: Membership plans
features.description: Create a plan for each type of membership, with a name, a code, a price, a currency, a monthly or annual billing interval and a description of what is included. Set plans active or inactive, and plans that already have payments are protected from deletion so your records stay intact.

features.title: Payment gateways
features.description: Connect the payment providers your organisation already uses, including Stripe, PayPal and GoCardless for SEPA Direct Debit, or record bank transfers. Cash is always available as a payment method without any connection.

features.title: Members directory
features.description: Find any member by name, email or ID and filter the list by status: active, cancelling, cancelled or inactive. Open a profile to see everything about that person, or export the list as a CSV file.

features.title: Import existing members
features.description: Bring your current members across with a CSV upload. Map your columns to Donorfit’s fields, preview the records, and download a list of any rows that could not be imported. An import history keeps track of every file.

features.title: Email notifications and templates
features.description: Choose which emails go out automatically, such as a notice for each new application, a confirmation when a membership is approved and a PDF receipt. Adjust the wording, colours and logo of each template and check the result in a live preview.

features.title: Team and roles
features.description: Invite colleagues and volunteers to your workspace and decide what each role can see. A treasurer can work on payments while an intake volunteer reviews applications, without everyone having access to everything.

steps.title: Connect a payment gateway
steps.description: Link the provider your organisation uses so your form can accept payments. Cash needs no connection.

steps.title: Create your membership plans
steps.description: Set up the plans people can choose, with their price and monthly or annual billing interval.

steps.title: Build and publish your application form
steps.description: Pick the fields you need in the form builder, then share the link or QR code, or embed the form on your website.

steps.title: Review applications
steps.description: Approve each submission to create the member and their subscription, or reject it. You can also let some submissions be approved automatically.

steps.title: Manage members and payments
steps.description: Follow subscriptions, billing dates, receipts and cancellations from the members directory and each member’s profile.

benefits.title: Less administration

benefits.title: Member information in order

benefits.title: Clear view of payments
benefits.description: See active subscriptions, upcoming billings and failed payments without assembling reports.

benefits.description: The activity log records registrations, payments, plan changes and cancellations as they happen.

benefits.title: Work shared safely
benefits.description: Roles let several people help with membership while each only sees the sections they need.

audiences.description: Run supporter or friends memberships with a monthly or annual contribution, and keep each supporter’s payments and history on one profile.

audiences.title: Community organisations
audiences.description: Mosque committees, community centres and neighbourhood groups can replace paper registration with one online form and a clear list of current members.

audiences.description: Parents’ associations, youth groups and social clubs can collect the details they need, such as emergency contacts, as part of the application.

audiences.title: Other membership-based organisations
audiences.description: Sports clubs, cultural societies and professional networks can use plans, forms and recurring billing in the way that fits their own rules.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: A setup guide in the dashboard takes you through three steps: connect a payment gateway, create a membership plan, and build and publish your registration form. Once the form is live you can share it and start receiving applications.

faqs.question: Can we offer more than one membership plan?
faqs.answer: Yes. Create as many plans as you need, each with its own name, code, price, currency, billing interval and description. You can also let applicants choose more than one plan on the same form.

faqs.question: How do people apply for membership?
faqs.answer: Applicants fill in your online application form. You can share it as a direct link or QR code, or embed it on your website with an HTML snippet. The form can include personal details, address, plan choice, payment method, a signature and any extra fields you add.

faqs.question: Do we have to approve every application?
faqs.answer: You decide. With manual review, every submission waits for an administrator. With conditional auto-approval, submissions are approved automatically unless a rule applies, for example when SEPA bank details need checking. Free plans can skip the approval queue.

faqs.question: Which payment methods can members use?
faqs.answer: That depends on the gateways you connect. Donorfit supports Stripe, PayPal and GoCardless (for SEPA Direct Debit), as well as bank transfer and cash. Cash is always available without a connection.

faqs.question: Are membership fees collected automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes. When an application is approved, Donorfit creates a subscription that bills monthly or annually through the connected gateway. Each subscription shows its next billing date, and failed billings are flagged so your team can follow up.

faqs.question: What happens when a member cancels?
faqs.answer: You can schedule a cancellation for a future date or cancel straight away. Until the end date the member is shown as cancelling, and a scheduled cancellation can be removed if they change their mind. Each step is recorded in the member’s activity log.

faqs.question: Can we move our existing members into Donorfit?
faqs.answer: Yes. Upload a CSV file, map its columns to Donorfit’s fields and check the preview before importing. Rows with missing or invalid data are listed separately so you can correct them.

faqs.question: Can several people in our team work in Donorfit?
faqs.answer: Yes. Invite team members and give each one a role. A role decides which sections of the app that person can open.

cta.title: Start your membership programme in Donorfit
cta.body: Create your plans, publish your application form and keep every member and payment in one place. Get started yourself or book a demo with our team.

whatBody: MoneyPool is the crowdfunding solution inside Donorfit. Your organisation creates a fundraising campaign for one specific project, such as a roof repair, a water well or winter food packs, and sets a goal.
Supporters each contribute the amount they can. Everyone sees the target and how close the campaign is, so a group of smaller gifts adds up to one project your community funded together.

money-pool.dashboardTitle: See every campaign’s progress at a glance
money-pool.dashboardSub: Each campaign has its own overview, so your team always knows how much has come in, from how many people and how much is still needed.

legend.body: A progress bar shows how close the campaign is to its target and how much is still needed.

legend.body: The latest gifts with name (or Anonymous), amount and payment method.

money-pool.stepsTitle: Launch your first campaign in four steps
money-pool.stepsSub: From an idea on the committee agenda to a campaign your whole community can follow.

steps.title: Create a campaign
steps.body: Name the project, set the fundraising goal, explain what the money pays for and choose a deadline.

steps.title: Share it with your community
steps.body: Send the campaign link to the people most likely to help, and let them pass it on to their own networks.

steps.title: Collect contributions
steps.body: Supporters give by payment link, card or SEPA Direct Debit, can choose to appear as Anonymous, and each receives their own receipt. Payments go to your organisation’s account.

steps.title: Track progress
steps.body: Follow the total, the number of contributors and every new contribution as they come in. Your team decides when to close the campaign and delivers the project.
